text.en:
The barangays of Cabatan, Danan, Limason, Lumbal, Bio-os Maraya, Linoguayan,
Waling-Waling, Kapatagan, Cogon, Lunib, Maculay, and Sagucan all in the Municipality of Margosatubig,
Province of Zamboanga del Sur, are hereby separated from said municipality and constituted into a distinct
and independent municipality in the same province to be known as the Municipality of Vincenzo Sagun. The
seat of government of the new municipality shall be in Barangay Cabatan.

The boundaries of the Municipality of Vincenzo Sagun are as follows:
"Beginning at point 1, center of the mouth of Timboligud River; thence, following the upstream course of said
River; thence, following center of Mount Tamura called point 2; thence, following straight line to the center of
Mount Biga; thence, a straight line until it intersects longitude 5.390 E to the boundary of Dimataling
Municipality; thence, following the shoreline in a clockwise direction back to point 1, the point of beginning."
